statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and a sensation of irregular heartbeat
These symptoms are concerning for arrhythmia
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
CPT code 93229 (Mobile cardiac telemetry) was billed
The denial reason code is CO-50
The service was not deemed medically necessary under Federal Medicare guidelines
Mobile cardiac telemetry is medically necessary to capture continuous rhythm data and correlate symptoms with potential cardiac events over an extended monitoring period
